content: Write a memo to staff about a new mandatory security training.

**MEMORANDUM**

**TO:** All Employees
**FROM:** [Name], [Title — e.g., Chief Information Security Officer]
**DATE:** [Date]
**SUBJECT:** Mandatory Security Awareness Training — Complete by [Deadline]

---

Beginning [start date], all employees are required to complete our updated Security Awareness Training. This annual requirement supports our obligations under [regulation/policy, e.g., SOC 2, HIPAA, company Information Security Policy] and reflects the growing sophistication of phishing and social engineering attacks targeting organizations like ours.

**What the training covers**

- Recognizing phishing, smishing, and business email compromise attempts
- Password hygiene and multi-factor authentication
- Safe handling of confidential and customer data
- Device security for remote and hybrid work
- How and when to report a suspected incident

**Who must complete it**

All employees, contractors, and interns with access to company systems. There are no exemptions.

**Time required and deadline**

The training takes approximately [30–45] minutes and may be completed in more than one sitting. It must be finished by **[Deadline date]**. Please treat this as work time and schedule it accordingly with your manager.

**How to access it**

1. Log in to [platform name] at [URL] using your company credentials.
2. Select "[Course Name]" from your assigned learning path.
3. Complete all modules and the brief knowledge check at the end (a score of [80]% is required to pass; the assessment may be retaken).

You will receive a confirmation email upon completion. Automated reminders will be sent at [interval] to anyone with an outstanding assignment.

**If the deadline is missed**

Managers will receive completion reports on [date]. Employees who have not completed the training by [Deadline] may have system access restricted until the requirement is satisfied, consistent with [Policy #].

**Questions or accommodations**

If you need an accommodation, have difficulty accessing the platform, or believe you have already completed equivalent training, contact [name/team] at [email] or [extension].

Thank you for taking the time to complete this. Most security incidents begin with a single click, and the awareness you build here is our most effective defense.
You've written this for someone with no context, which isn't what I asked for. Rewrite it for a reader who already knows the background.

The content has changed meaningfully since last cycle — the phishing and BEC modules were rebuilt around [the incidents we saw in Q[X] / the new attack patterns], so skimming on the assumption you've seen it before won't serve you well.

Managers get completion reports on [date]. Access restrictions apply after [Deadline] per [Policy #].

Accommodations, access problems, or credit for equivalent external training: [name] at [email].
